content.text:
The image shows three oxygen atoms in a bent chain, which is ozone. The left oxygen carries a negative charge and is joined by a single bond to the central oxygen. The central oxygen carries a positive charge and is joined by a double bond to the right oxygen.

Reading left to right, the SMILES is [O-][O+]=O. The charges sum to zero, matching neutral ozone.

SMILES: [O-][O+]=O
